title: Mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar
body:
chasma falak ne dekha yeh manzar
ran ko chala humshakle payambar
thame kamar yeh kehte the sarwar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. cheenliya ankhon ka ujala
gham mein tumhare din hain andhera
beta zaeefi khati hain thokar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. kaise sahenge beta tera gham
qaima qaima hota hain matam
dar pe khadi hain zainab -e- muztar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. dil mein mere ek hashr bapa hain
kise kaho yeh karbobala hain
koi nahi hain munis-o-yawar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. khoon -e- jigar ankhon se rawan hain
bhai mera abbas kaha hai
daag hain taaza bhai ka dil par
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. karbobala akbar ki jawani
hai yeh mere nana ki nashani
lakhte jigar hum shakle payambar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. kaise jiyegi maa dukhyari
gham mein tumhare karti hain zari
hota hain veera mera bhara ghar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. tegh -o- tabar yeh zulm ke saye
beta sabhi hain khoon ke pyase
tegh -o- tabar yeh shaam ka lashkar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
8. shai ko sukune khalb idhar tha
ankhon main jab tak noor-e- nazar tha
shai yeh sada dete the barabar
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
9. badke farid ab kaun sambhale
door bohat hain chahane wale
nauha yahi tha shai ke laboun par
<<MINI>>
mehlan mehlan ya ali akbar . . . . .
